title: Fast Entry / Keyboard Workstation Capability Matrix
assessment: P09-B/C/D may proceed only as thin adapters over existing semantic authoring, selection and history authorities. A second note-entry, rhythm or history authority is not admitted.

capabilities.existing_implementation: packages/editor-keypad/src/index.ts exposes EDITOR_KEYPAD_CONTRACT_VERSION 1.0.0 and ACTION_ID_ONLY actions for duration, rests, accidentals, dots, triplet, tie and slur.
capabilities.canonical_mutation_owner: None at contract layer; the contract only identifies an admitted action.
capabilities.missing_gap: No bounded desktop keyboard command vocabulary maps physical key gestures to the admitted semantic actions and authoring primitives.
capabilities.reuse_plan: Reuse EditorKeypadActionId for editing commands where the semantic operation already exists. Add only a versioned keyboard command-intent contract; do not add mutation logic here.
capabilities.risk_or_fail_closed_boundary: Unknown command/version must be rejected. Glyph metadata and DOM/SVG identity must never become semantic authority.

capabilities.existing_implementation: commitSessionKeypadActionV4 routes through executeSafeEditorKeypadActionV4 using current SemanticAddressV3 selection and commits the result through unified EditorHistoryV4.
capabilities.canonical_mutation_owner: Existing V4 semantic authoring primitives reached by EditorSessionV4.
capabilities.browser_ui_surface: Keypad buttons and existing app controller paths.
capabilities.missing_gap: No desktop key gesture adapter invokes the same session command path.
capabilities.reuse_plan: Keyboard edit gestures should call the same app/session keypad action path and let existing selection rebinding rules apply.
capabilities.risk_or_fail_closed_boundary: Null, stale or wrong-kind semantic selection must fail before mutation; keyboard layer must not synthesize renderer-derived targets.

capabilities.existing_implementation: packages/editor-keypad-rhythm-safe-v4/src/index.ts routes duration/rest/dot changes to executeRhythmAuthoringV4; non-timing keypad operations remain delegated to editor-keypad-execution-v4.
capabilities.missing_gap: Keyboard shortcuts are absent, but no new rhythm implementation is required.
capabilities.reuse_plan: Map admitted keyboard intents to existing keypad action IDs or existing authoring methods. Never compute or write timing in the browser adapter.
capabilities.risk_or_fail_closed_boundary: Unsupported timing, stale target, notation orphan risk and cross-staff conflict remain rejected by the shared rhythm authority.

capabilities.existing_implementation: Authoring workspace exposes active Voice, pitch, duration and enterNoteAtSelection. Position note entry is explicit-rest-only and commits through EditorSessionV4 history.
capabilities.canonical_mutation_owner: Existing position/note-entry V4 authoring path and EditorSessionV4.
capabilities.missing_gap: No keyboard command surface selects entry pitch/duration/voice and triggers the existing note-entry operation.
capabilities.reuse_plan: Keyboard fast-entry should update noncanonical authoring preferences through existing controller setters and invoke enterNoteAtSelection; it must not create a parallel insertion engine.
capabilities.risk_or_fail_closed_boundary: Current explicit-rest-only admission remains authoritative. Keyboard entry must not invent missing timing/topology or silently overwrite occupied music.

capabilities.capability: Active Voice / entry pitch / entry duration state
capabilities.existing_implementation: Authoring workspace maintains activeVoiceOrdinal, pitch and duration as browser presentation/workflow state and resets it on document change; canonicalAuthority is false.
capabilities.canonical_mutation_owner: No canonical owner for preferences; canonical score mutation occurs only when an admitted authoring action commits.
capabilities.missing_gap: No defined keyboard-intent semantics for changing these preferences.
capabilities.reuse_plan: P09-B may expose bounded intents that call setActiveVoice, setEntryPitch and setEntryDuration; state stays explicitly noncanonical.
capabilities.risk_or_fail_closed_boundary: Do not introduce hidden canonical cursor state. Unsupported Voice/pitch/duration values must be rejected by existing bounds.

capabilities.existing_implementation: packages/score-editor-browser-app/src/measure-navigation.ts navigates previous/next global measure frame on the same part/staff, carries exact containing-event onset when available, and reselects through SemanticAddressV3. It has no history mutation authority.
capabilities.canonical_mutation_owner: None; navigation changes semantic selection only.
capabilities.browser_ui_surface: Previous/next measure controls in the authoring palette.
capabilities.missing_gap: No keyboard navigation binding exists; event-within-measure and staff navigation are not established as general keyboard commands by this audit.
capabilities.reuse_plan: Reuse navigateMeasure for admitted previous/next measure commands. Define any finer-grained navigation separately only after semantic ordering is explicit.
capabilities.risk_or_fail_closed_boundary: Do not derive musical navigation from renderer coordinates. Missing frame/staff/measure context must fail closed.

capabilities.existing_implementation: EditorSessionV4 / EditorHistoryV4 is the unified history authority; existing tests assert exact score+notation restoration for professional and authoring edits.
capabilities.browser_ui_surface: Existing app/history navigation controls and SDK/session methods.
capabilities.missing_gap: No focus-safe keyboard binding for standard undo/redo is established by current P09 audit.
capabilities.reuse_plan: P09 command execution should call existing history navigation only; one accepted semantic edit remains one history revision.
capabilities.risk_or_fail_closed_boundary: Keyboard layer must never write history directly or coalesce unrelated edits without a separately admitted transaction contract.

capabilities.existing_implementation: P08 professional selection uses current-revision SemanticAddressV3 endpoints; professional range UI declares EditorHistoryV4 as history authority and renderer coordinates as non-authoritative.
capabilities.canonical_mutation_owner: Selection model is semantic/noncanonical; edits route through P08 professional workstation/session authorities.
capabilities.browser_ui_surface: Professional range toolbar and structure inspector in STScoreEditorProfessionalApp.
capabilities.missing_gap: Keyboard extension/Shift-selection behavior is not yet implemented as a focus-safe desktop gesture layer.
capabilities.reuse_plan: Future Shift-selection should reuse P08 semantic endpoints/range model rather than create a keyboard-only range representation.
capabilities.risk_or_fail_closed_boundary: Stale revision endpoints must be rejected; renderer hit order/DOM ids must not define the range.

capabilities.existing_implementation: viewport-presentation.ts installs a root keydown listener for Ctrl/Cmd +/-/0, arrows, PageUp/PageDown, Home/End when the event target is inside the score viewport.
capabilities.canonical_mutation_owner: None; existing listener is presentation-only zoom/pan/page navigation.
capabilities.missing_gap: There is no centralized edit-keyboard adapter and the existing viewport handler has no general text-input/contenteditable exclusion because it currently only owns viewport presentation gestures.
capabilities.reuse_plan: P09-C should add a separate focus-safe adapter with explicit editable-target exclusion and conflict arbitration with viewport shortcuts, then delegate semantic commands to existing controller APIs.
capabilities.risk_or_fail_closed_boundary: Never hijack input, textarea, select, contenteditable or host-reserved shortcuts. Do not let both viewport and editing adapters execute one gesture.

capabilities.existing_implementation: P06 SDK has reusable mount/update/unmount/remount lifecycle tests and presentation-host lifecycle boundaries; current main also contains S06E source-note identity mapping at the SDK/import boundary.
capabilities.canonical_mutation_owner: SDK host is non-authoritative; EditorSessionV4 and canonical documents remain authoritative.
capabilities.browser_ui_surface: Generic SDK hosts plus standalone/professional browser artifacts.
capabilities.missing_gap: Keyboard workstation exposure is not part of the versioned public SDK contract yet.
capabilities.reuse_plan: Keep P09 browser adapter internal until behavior is qualified; expose only a bounded versioned SDK capability if host-driven keyboard intents are later required.
capabilities.risk_or_fail_closed_boundary: Do not make SDK lifecycle or host state a second score/history authority. Preserve source identity revision guards introduced by S06E.

capabilities.existing_implementation: Current authoring/professional UI is button/touch based and prior stages include WebKit/mobile regressions; physical iPhone/Safari P08-E4 qualification remains a separate pending gate.
capabilities.browser_ui_surface: Responsive authoring and professional browser UIs.
capabilities.missing_gap: P09 keyboard workflow is desktop-oriented; it must not regress touch controls or become required for core authoring.
capabilities.reuse_plan: Keep touch UI operational and add P09 as progressive enhancement. Run dedicated WebKit regression when shared browser code changes.
capabilities.risk_or_fail_closed_boundary: Do not declare physical iPhone/Safari PASS from automated keyboard tests; do not expose professional artifact to production through P09.

admission_for_next_stage.reason: Existing semantic action, note-entry, navigation and history primitives are sufficient for a command-intent layer without a second mutation engine.
constraints: Keyboard contract is intent-only and versioned.
All score mutations delegate to existing controller/session primitives.
No hidden canonical cursor or timing state.
